subject: MeridianHealth demo scheduling blocked by vendor onboarding & security checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Li <s.li@meridianhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Hi Nikhil + Lauren,

Thanks for the earlier conversation. We're excited to see Redwood in action. Before we lock a live demo with our product and clinical teams we need to complete our vendor onboarding checklist (attached) and have an NDA in place. Procurement has requested the completed questionnaire and a signed NDA prior to provisioning a demo environment.

Proposed live demo slot: Dec 3, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT. Does that work on your side? If procurement needs more time we can adjust.

I've attached the questionnaire for your security and engineering teams to review.

Attachment: Meridian_Questionnaire_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
MeridianHealth
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <s.li@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the packet. Quick note on sequencing so we don't overbook: our standard request is that the vendor questionnaire and NDA are completed before we reserve a full demo slot with product and clinical teams. The reason is that several of our demo resources are booked weeks in advance and we want to make sure the session will proceed.

Two options here:
1) If procurement can complete the questionnaire and sign the NDA by EOD Dec 2, we can hold the Dec 3 10:00 AM PT slot.
2) Otherwise, we should either schedule a short 30-minute pre-demo security sync (to walk through the questionnaire with your security lead) or move the live demo to the week of Dec 7 (we have more capacity then).

Heads-up: a few members of our exec and integrations teams are traveling Dec 3–5, so Dec 6–8 is tight from our side. Dec 9 onward is much easier.

I'll loop in our internal ops to support expedited onboarding and DocuSign for the NDA.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Li <s.li@meridianhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@meridianhealth.com>, Vendor Portal <vendor-portal@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Thanks Nikhil —

Procurement just flagged that they can't complete the questionnaire until we finish the vendor portal onboarding (two-step intake). The portal team needs the vendor to register; they then push questionnaire access. That process usually takes 48–72 hours after registration. I've copied Portal (vendor-portal@meridianhealth.com) with instructions.

Would Redwood be open to a 30-minute security sync with our security lead (Alex Carter) to walk through the questionnaire and any showstoppers prior to portal completion? If we can align on outstanding items in a short call, procurement may expedite the portal step.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_instructions.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if a pre-demo sync on Dec 2 (any time before 1 PM PT) works — Alex is flexible in the morning.

Best,
Samantha
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Team — forwarding Meridian's note. TL;DR: procurement requires vendor portal registration before questionnaire access; they asked for a 30-min security sync with their security lead (Alex). Execs + some SEs are traveling Dec 3–5, so Dec 3 is risky to hold.

Options I recommend (pick one quickly):
A) Offer a 30-minute security sync on Dec 2 (we can staff with an SE + security SME). If it goes well, procurement may fast-track the portal and we can keep Dec 3 if they finish.
B) Proactively move the live demo to Dec 9 10:00 AM PT to avoid last-minute juggling and ensure product + clinical have full availability.

Operational asks: Lauren — can you take DocuSign NDA and send it today? Marissa — can you ping Sales Ops to see if the portal registration can be expedited (we may need to provide a vendor contact and DUNS). Karthik — can you prep a 1-page security summary and the short packet (we can attach to the pre-demo sync invite)?

I'll draft the external reply proposing both a security sync and a fallback demo date.

- Nikhil
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Agree with the two-prong approach. I'll take DocuSign NDA now and send to Samantha. Marissa — I'll loop Sales Ops and copy you; Marissa, can you escalate the vendor-portal registration (we'll provide DUNS + PO box) and ask for 48-hour turnaround?

Karthik — please attach the 1-pager security summary to the sync invite. Tentative fallback slot: Dec 9, 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks — Lauren
Director, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <s.li@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MeridianHealth: scheduling demo + vendor questionnaire

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick responses and for looping Alex. Two options for the immediate next step so we don't lose momentum:

1) Pre-demo security sync: We can do a tightly scoped 30-minute call on Dec 2 at 11:00 AM PT with our Solutions Engineer (Karthik) and our Security SME. We'll walk through the questionnaire highlights and any redlines. If Alex can make that time we will send the one-page security summary and the security packet in advance.

2) Move the live demo to Dec 9 at 10:00 AM PT as a fallback if the portal/onboarding timeline doesn't allow procurement to finish before Dec 3.

I've asked our team to start the DocuSign NDA (Lauren is sending) and attached our security packet for Alex's review. If you confirm the Dec 2 11:00 AM PT sync, I'll send the invite and the pre-read.

Attachments: Security_Packet_v1.zip (zip)
DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/NDA-7831
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/D-7831

Looking forward — please confirm which option you prefer.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
